name: filespin
description: FileSpin for coding agents: the FileSpin MCP server (developer docs, API reference and your account's assets) plus the filespin-developer and filespin skills

interface.longDescription:
FileSpin is a digital asset management (DAM) platform for images, videos and documents. Connect it to work on your FileSpin library in plain language.

- Find assets by keyword, metadata, date, auto-tags or face, and see thumbnails.
- Save files to FileSpin from a link or from your computer, with names, tags, metadata and collections.
- Prepare outputs: social sizes, formats, watermarks, background removal, upscaling, generative fill and video renditions.
- Create branded share pages for review, track approvals and notify teammates.
- Look up FileSpin's developer docs and API reference while you build.

You sign in with your FileSpin account, and every action runs with your own permissions. FileSpin never deletes files from chat: deleting stays in the FileSpin dashboard.
capabilities: Save files from links or your computer
Resize, convert, watermark and AI-edit images
Create share pages and track approvals
defaultPrompt: Find our latest product photos in FileSpin
